# Code Formatting Guidelines

## Markdown Formatting
- Use Markdown formatting in documentation
- Start code blocks with four backticks
- Include language identifier after backticks
- Add filepath comments for specific file locations
- Use line comments to indicate existing code

## Code Style
- Use type hints for Python functions
- Follow PEP 8 guidelines
- Add docstrings for classes and functions
- Include error handling
- Add comprehensive logging

## Example Code Block Format
````python
// filepath: /path/to/file
# ...existing code...
new_code_here()
# ...existing code...
`````
